{{Quote|Fekk, Gelss, get ready for action.|Shinqo, to Fekk and Gelss|<ref name="TORFA" />}}
'''Fekk''' was a [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] who served under [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Jet Nebula]] aboard the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] ''[[Auriga Fire]]''. The ship originally [[Privateer/Legends|worked]] for the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]], but eventually the crew became more inclined to answer the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]]. During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], when the ''Auriga Fire'' intercepted the starship ''[[Cinzia]]'', Fekk was among the crew members who joined the [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Shinqo]] in mutiny in hopes of taking the ''Cinzia'' for themselves.

Holding Nebula at [[Blaster/Legends|blasterpoint]], Shinqo ordered Fekk and fellow Sullustan [[Gelss]] to prepare for action, but the ''Cinzia'' suddenly [[Self-destruct mechanism/Legends|exploded]]. In the confusion, [[Clunker|Nebula's droid]] grabbed Shinqo's blaster and pointed it at the Rodian, who yielded. With the ship back under Nebula's control, the crew found a [[Navigation computer/Legends|navicomp]] and a nest that produced [[Fastbreeder|hex droids]]&mdash;an apprehensive type of [[Droid/Legends|droid]] created by [[Lema Xandret]]&mdash;amidst the ''Cinzia''{{'s}} wreckage.

==Biography==
Fekk, a [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]], served under [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Jet Nebula]] on the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] ''[[Auriga Fire]]'', working as a [[Privateer/Legends|privateer]] for the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. At some point during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], however, the ''Auriga Fire''{{'s}} true employer became the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]]&mdash;although the ship still answered to the Republic, the crew was more concerned with pleasing the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]]. Several [[Standard year/Legends|years]] after the [[Treaty of Coruscant]], Fekk became associated with Nebula's [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[First Mate/Legends|first mate]], [[Shinqo]]. Fekk supported Shinqo when the Rodian planned a mutiny against Nebula, and the Sullustan took part in the betrayal when the ''Auriga Fire'' intercepted the starship ''[[Cinzia]]'', which the mutineers intended to take for themselves.<ref name="TORFA" />

Shinqo held Nebula at [[Blaster/Legends|blasterpoint]], forcing him to contact the ''Cinzia'' and relay to the interdicted ship's crew that their vessel was to be boarded. The Rodian then called for Fekk and [[Gelss]], another Sullustan who supported the Rodian's mutiny, to ready themselves for action; however, the ''Cinzia'' suddenly [[Self-destruct mechanism/Legends|self-destructed]]. In the ensuing confusion, Nebula's [[J8O soldier droid]], [[Clunker]], grabbed Shinqo and took his blaster. The [[Droid/Legends|droid]] turned the weapon on the mutineer, who accepted his place back under Nebula's command, ending the mutiny. At Nebula's orders, the crew of the ''Auriga Fire'' scavenged the wreckage of the ''Cinzia'', finding a battered [[Navigation computer/Legends|navigation computer]] and a strange object that was eventually discovered to be a nest that produced [[Fastbreeder|hex droids]]&mdash;a deadly type of droid [[Engineer/Legends|engineered]] by [[Lema Xandret]] to protect her daughter, [[Cinzia Xandret|Cinzia]], after whom the ship had been named.<ref name="TORFA" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|And be glad we don't want your ship, as well.|Shinqo, to Nebula, on the mutineers' desires|<ref name="TORFA" />}}
Fekk was a privateer and pirate who betrayed Captain Jet Nebula by joining Shinqo and several other crew members of the ''Auriga Fire'' in mutiny. Fekk, Shinqo, and the rest of the mutineers executed their betrayal while intercepting the ''Cinzia'', hoping to gain the starship for themselves.<ref name="TORFA" />

==Behind the scenes==
Fekk was mentioned in ''[[The Old Republic: Fatal Alliance]]'', a [[2010]] novel by [[Sean Williams]] that served as a tie-in to the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' [[Star Wars video games|MMORPG]].<ref name="TORFA" />
